summary: Two-day Stone Harbor weekend for Wile Events: welcome party at Stone Harbor Golf Club Friday and the Jamie x Greg wedding at The Reeds Saturday, with studio processing, install, flip, night strikes and a Monday studio return. Recommend a team of 2 Friday (van), 4 for the wedding install with a 26ft U-Haul parked near the venue for the strike crew of 3.

zones.name: Welcome party
zones.tasks: Entry path lanterns (24), raffle display, 2 bar statements, credenza, high/low tops, fireplace

zones.name: Ceremony
zones.tasks: Altar ground gardens (3× 11", 4× 9" Lomey, 4 trays) + 14 aisle tray meadows
zones.notes: Highest-touch zone; done by 3:00pm photo ready

zones.name: Cocktail hour
zones.tasks: Seating chart wall insert, 2 bars, 8 low tops, 4 high tops, gift table, welcome sign

zones.name: Reception
zones.tasks: Sweetheart, 16 guest tables in 4 designs (~300 rental pieces), cake, 2 satellite bars
zones.notes: Shares crew with cocktail once ceremony is done

zones.name: Flip
zones.tasks: Altar front pieces → sweetheart floor; aisle meadows → stage front

steps.label: Arrive at studio, load 26ft truck (Friday rentals returned)

vehicles.label: Wedding: 26ft box truck
vehicles.notes: Stays parked near the venue for the strike team; returned Monday

base_fee_note: Friday and Saturday on site. Monday studio return is a next-day delivery for team safety after a 1:30am strike, so no extra base fee.
logistics_notes: ~300 rental pieces (29 lamps, 136 votives, 52 tapers, 2 candelabra) fill a 26ft truck; load ~1–1.25 hr with 4.
Friday rentals ride back to the studio and go out again on Saturday's truck.
Garden State Parkway south of exit 105 allows trucks; confirm the route to Stone Harbor.
reasoning: Ceremony is the heaviest zone (21 ground pieces) and must be photo ready by 3pm, so 2 people there.
Cocktail + reception share 2 people once the ceremony is done; 4 total fits the 10am–4:30pm window.
Strike: ~300 pieces in a 2-hour window with careful packing needs 3.
red_flags: Timeline shows a team of 3 for the wedding install but the zones need 4.
No breakdown hard stop listed: confirm with The Reeds.
missing_info: Loading dock / parking at The Reeds for a 26ft truck
Who unloads at the studio Monday
client_questions: Is there a dock or a spot to leave a 26ft truck overnight near The Reeds?

similar_jobs.why: Same client and venue type; reference job
